subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Driver Shortage Crisis
description: A 60-second lesson on Driver Shortage Crisis.

hook.text: The US trucking industry is short 80,000 drivers and the gap is growing. Freight moves only if drivers do.

buildup.text: Long hours, time away from home, and physical demands make trucking a hard career to fill.

discovery.text: The average trucker is 55 years old. Retirements are outpacing new entrants by a wide margin.

twist.text: Higher pay helps attract drivers but raises freight costs for every company and consumer.

climax.text: Autonomous trucks may eventually fill the gap—but regulations, safety, and technology remain hurdles.

punchline.text: No drivers, no deliveries. The shortage is everyone's problem.

quiz.question: How many drivers is the US trucking industry short?
